input.new_string:
"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import time


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Build a signed, HTTP-only cookie payload for the logged-in user."""
    issued_at = str(int(time.time()))
    payload = f"{user_id}:{issued_at}"
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

    return {
        "name": "session",
        "value": f"{payload}:{signature}",
        "http_only": True,
        "secure": True,
        "same_site": "Strict",
        "path": "/",
    }
